steps.tx: **Helminthic and protozoal infections** affect over 1 billion people, with soil transmitted worms causing thirty percent prevalence in Indian school children under fourteen years. Malaria contributes five hundred and twenty eight thousand deaths globally in the year two thousand and twenty two, mostly in Africa. Ascariasis alone affects eight hundred million people, while Entamoeba causes fifty thousand amoebic dysentery deaths yearly. These infections dominate anaemia, malnutrition, and stunting in tropical practice and appear in ward rounds within weeks.
steps.say: Helminthic and protozoal infections affect over one billion people. Soil worms affect nearly one third of school children here. Malaria causes over five hundred thousand deaths globally. Roundworm alone affects eight hundred million people and amoeba causes many dysentery deaths.

steps.tx: **Risk factors** are faecal oral spread, open defecation, contaminated water, and monsoon flooding. Children aged 1 to 6 years, slum dwellers, and food handlers face highest exposure. Vector borne protozoa cluster where Anopheles and Aedes breed. About seventy percent of school deworming benefit appears only when sanitation improves too, so drugs alone forgive poor hygiene for a short time only.
steps.say: Risk factors are faecal oral spread, open defecation, unsafe water and monsoon flooding. Small children, slum dwellers and food handlers have the highest exposure. Vector diseases remain where mosquitoes breed warmly. Deworming helps most when sanitation improves too. Drugs alone leave poor hygiene only briefly.

steps.tx: **Life cycles** explain every clinical choice. Hookworm larvae penetrate skin, travel through veins to lungs, and are swallowed to colon where adults suck nought point nought three to nought point two millilitre blood daily. Ascaris larvae repeat this lung migration and cough occurs in Loeffler syndrome. Taenia solium eggs eaten in undercooked pork release oncospheres that encyst in muscle and brain. Each migration phase creates the organ damage seen clinically.
steps.say: Life cycles explain every clinical choice. Hookworm larvae enter skin, travel to lungs and are swallowed to colon where adults suck blood. Ascaris repeats this lung migration and causes cough. Pork cysticercosis cysts form in muscle and brain. Each migration phase creates the organ damage seen.

steps.tx: **Clinical features** of hookworm anaemia are iron deficiency with microcytic indices, pallor, koilonychia, and high output failure at haemoglobin below 6 grams per decilitre. Ascariasis gives colic, subacute intestinal obstruction, and biliary colic in 10% with worm in bile duct. Amoebic dysentery shows blood mucus stools with flask shaped ulcers and liver abscess in 10% of invasive cases. Cysticercal seizures are the commonest adult onset epilepsy cause here.
steps.say: Hookworm anaemia is iron deficiency with pallor and nail changes. Ascariasis causes colic, block and bile duct migration. Amoebic dysentery presents with bloody mucus stools and liver abscess. Brain cysts cause adult seizures and are the commonest cause of adult epilepsy here.

steps.tx: **Kala azar and malaria** complete the protozoal map. Visceral leishmaniasis shows fever beyond 2 weeks, splenomegaly above 5 centimetres, and pancytopenia with high globulin gap. Malaria paroxysms last eight to 12 hours with chills then sweat, and cerebral malaria kills above 20% without prompt therapy. Falciparum touches 5% of all malaria but causes 95% of deaths. Giardia gives greasy foul stools with flatulence and weight loss.
steps.say: Kala azar presents with long fever, big spleen and low counts with high globulin. Malaria paroxysms run many hours with chills then sweat. Cerebral malaria causes many deaths without prompt treatment. Falciparum causes few cases but most deaths. Giardia causes greasy foul stools with weight loss.

steps.tx: **First test** for stool parasites is three saline and iodine mounts with concentration technique to raise yield from 60% to above 90%. The gold standard for malaria is thick and thin films read by two microscopists, supplemented by quantitative rapid antigen tests. For cysticercosis, computed tomography shows multiple ring enhancing lesions below 20 millimetres. Liver abscess aspiration shows anchovy paste pus that is usually sterile on routine culture.
steps.say: Do three stool mounts to raise yield. The gold standard for malaria is thick and thin films read carefully. Brain scan images present small ring lesions in cysticercosis. Liver pus looks like anchovy paste and routine culture is usually sterile.

steps.tx: **Serology and speciation** settle doubtful cases. Amoebic serology is positive in 95% of liver abscess but only 20% in dysentery. Stool antigen tests detect Giardia in 95% sensitivity. Kala azar rapid tests using rK39 exceed 90% sensitivity in Bihar. Stool egg counts above three hundred per gram indicate heavy worm load needing coexistence treatment. Always incubate fresh stool within thirty minutes because hookworm eggs clear fast in direct mounts.
steps.say: Serology confirms doubtful cases at the bedside. Amoebic serology identifies most liver abscess cases well. Stool antigen tests identify giardia sensitively in many cases. Kala azar rapid tests are accurate in Bihar here. Heavy egg counts indicate heavy worm load here. Read fresh stool quickly as hookworm eggs clear fast today.

steps.tx: **First line management** matches organism. Albendazole four hundred milligrams single dose cures ascariasis in 95% and hookworm in eighty percent, while a cysticidal agent 15 milligrams per kilogram suits neurocysticercosis with steroids. An antiamoebic agent eight hundred milligrams three times daily for 5 days treats invasive amoebiasis, followed by paromomycin for luminal clearance. Severe malaria gets a fast injectable agent two point four milligrams per kilogram at zero, twelve, and twenty four hours. Liposomal amphotericin single dose 10 milligrams per kilogram is preferred for kala azar.
steps.say: Check the organism first and then match treatment to it. Albendazole single dose clears roundworm well in many patients. The cysticidal agent with steroids helps brain cyst patients. The antiamoebic agent is given for invasive amoebiasis first. Severe malaria is treated with a fast injectable agent. Kala azar is treated with single dose liposomal amphotericin.

steps.tx: **Sequencing** prevents harm. Steroids must precede cysticidal drugs in neurocysticercosis to blunt inflammation, and antiepileptics continue for 2 years after cysts resolve. Do not kill worms inside the gut in obstruction without first ruling out complete block, as paralysed worms worsen blockage. Iron and the anthelmintic mainstay support hookworm anaemia alongside albendazole. Relapse prevention with nought point two five milligrams per kilogram for fourteen days needs normal G6PD levels.
steps.say: Sequence treatment to prevent harm in every patient. Give steroids before cyst killing drugs in brain cysts. Do not paralyse worms in complete bowel block today. Iron supports hookworm anaemia in dull patients. Vivax relapse prevention needs normal enzyme levels first.

steps.tx: **Complications and prognosis** are mostly preventable. Hookworm failure causes chronic anaemia with 2 year stunting in 3 million children, while amoebic abscess ruptures in 5% causing peritonitis. Neurocysticercosis recurs in thirty percent after stopping therapy early. Malaria deaths fall below 1% with a fast injectable agent but cerebral malaria leaves ten percent with sequelae. Mass deworming cuts worm intensity by sixty percent within 2 rounds of albendazole four hundred milligrams.
steps.say: Complications are mostly preventable. Hookworm causes chronic anaemia and stunting in millions of children. Amoebic abscess ruptures in few cases and causes peritonitis. Brain cysts recur if therapy stops early. Malaria deaths fall below one percent with a fast injectable agent but sequelae remain.

steps.tx: **High-yield for the exam** links drugs, doses, and danger. Albendazole four hundred milligrams single dose is the school programme dose. An antiamoebic agent eight hundred milligrams thrice daily for 5 days is amoebiasis dosing. A fast injectable agent two point four milligrams per kilogram is severe malaria dosing. Larva currens, Loeffler syndrome, and anchovy paste pus are classic vignettes. Steroids before the cysticidal agent is the safety rule asked every year.
steps.say: Keep drug, dose and danger together in mind. Albendazole single dose is the school programme dose. The antiamoebic agent is given thrice daily for five days. The fast injectable agent is given by weight in severe malaria. Steroids before cyst killing drugs is the safety rule asked every year.
